$comment: Ledger of sentinel fixes for scripts/verify-ancestry.ts (verify-no-regressions section 44).
Each entry pins a commit that carried a production-content fix that was
previously (or could be) dropped from main by a lineage reset, plus
content needles proving the fix survives at HEAD.
Enforced: fixCommit ancestry of HEAD (unless ancestryExpected=false) and
every contentNeedle present in the file at HEAD (read via git show, so a
dirty worktree cannot mask a regressed HEAD).
Protocol: when you land a fix that would be expensive to re-discover,
add an entry here IN THE SAME COMMIT. When a needle becomes obsolete
(content legitimately rewritten), update the entry with a supersededBy
note. Never delete history: mark obsolete, do not erase.
